operationContracts.name: 查看受信联系人状态与邀请说明
operationContracts.effect: Under allowed personal identity, key the body by user/account. Fetch enabled first; enable the contact-list query only when enabled===true. Show the first contact, pending/active status, name fallback and formatted phone; otherwise expose Add and the introductory expectations/eligibility explanation. Query keys include both identities, retry is false and staleTime is30000ms.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Access error retries accounts/check; loading/denied mounts no body. Query errors retry the failed query; disabled eligibility does not show Add. Country normalization selects the Korea wording only for KR and falls back to US for unsupported values.

operationContracts.name: 填写联系资料并同意后邀请受信联系人
operationContracts.effect: Require trimmed nonempty name, matching email syntax and explicit consent; send trimmed email, optional trimmed phone or null and relationship:null. A form ref blocks duplicate submits until finally. POST trusted_contact with captured account headers and blocked-email/phone expected errors; success upserts the returned contact then invalidates its list.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Blank/invalid/unconsented/pending input cannot submit. Closing/reopening increments an epoch: late responses may reconcile the captured query cache but cannot change a newer dialog or call onInvited. Blocked destinations show unavailable/try-another; other current errors show feedback. Closing is not proof that the service request was aborted.

operationContracts.name: 重发待接受的受信联系人邀请
operationContracts.effect: Expose Resend only for pending contacts with a usable email; normalize saved name/email, preserve optional phone/relationship and PUT the selected contact ID with captured account headers. Success gives feedback and invalidates the list.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Missing email and pending request disable Resend; payload construction rejects missing email. Failed resend retains recoverable feedback and does not become accepted status.

operationContracts.name: 确认取消邀请或移除受信联系人
operationContracts.effect: Use pending/active-specific Cancel invitation or Remove labels, open a separate confirmation and DELETE only the selected trusted_contact_id. Prevent confirmation submit while pending; success closes the removal dialog, shows feedback and invalidates the list.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Missing selected contact or a pending delete cannot invoke another mutation. Failed removal retains error feedback. The dialog close callback alone does not cancel or undo an in-flight deletion.

operationContracts.name: 查看静默与学习时段状态并切换编辑视图
operationContracts.effect: Require allowed access, eligibleNowOrBefore and enable_chatgpt_time_management_settings. Preserve quiet-hours/study-hours/time-management URL views with pathname/hash/state; distinguish scheduled from currently active and parent-managed from unsupported. Legacy always-on study maps through the legacy schedule adapter.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Denied access shows unavailable; loading/error offers scoped retry. Unsupported saved schedules remain unchanged and do not mount an editable schedule. A stale overview fetch error may still allow an already loaded editor; do not flatten these branches into a single failure.

operationContracts.name: 编辑并保存静默时段及其星期时间块
operationContracts.effect: Edit enabled state, weekdays and local/overnight start/end blocks; retain imported schedule reducer and validation policy, twelve-block UI limit and minimum-break error mapping. Save re-reads identity, eligibility, parent lock and supported state, then PATCH quiet_hours_schedule as JSON with captured account/signal. Close only after cancel/refetch confirms a nonerror result for the same identity.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: No changes, invalid/unsupported/managed state or in-flight controller prevents another write. Identity change/unmount aborts. Distinguish403 parent lock from generic denial and save/refetch error; retain draft for retry. Back uses the unsaved-changes dialog; Cancel exits without writing.

operationContracts.effect: Use the shared editor but PATCH study_hours_schedule. Legacy default-to-study becomes an all-week00:00..23:59 synthetic block; editing converts it through the source adapter, assigns a fresh web-study-hours ID and preserves existing recurring blocks. Count converted blocks against the twelve-block capacity.

operationContracts.name: 切换云端会话差异视图
operationContracts.effect: Load user preferences and account/user configuration separately; after both load, choose unified or split and PATCH wham/settings/user with git_diff_mode. On success replace the captured user-preferences query cache with the server response; mutation feedback is distinct from rendering.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Either query error exposes retry for both; missing data stays loading. Pending disables both diff options. Query retries are false; user preferences GET forwards its signal whereas config GET has no selected signal forwarding. Account/identity/service effects still require integration.

operationContracts.name: 验证预览并保存云端分支命名格式
operationContracts.effect: Keep a draft only while its captured server branch_format baseline still matches. Validate placeholder braces, known tags, generated maximum length, leading slash and allowed characters; preview examples and list available tag values. Changed valid input saves branch_format through the same scoped mutation/cache path.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Unchanged/invalid disables Save; pending disables the input and shows loading on Save. The selected Save disabled expression itself does not include pending, so additional duplicate suppression is delegated to the UI/mutation boundary. New server baseline discards the displayed stale draft; failed save keeps current edits and error feedback.
